title: Complete the pattern
description: A tiny transformer predicts the continuation associated with a repeated token. Find the two-head circuit that writes previous-token identity and uses it to retrieve the matching continuation.
behavior: At the final position, the model finds an earlier occurrence whose previous token matches the current token, then predicts the token that followed that occurrence.
task_goal: Identify both stages of the induction circuit, inspect the second head’s attention, and ablate both heads to establish causal involvement.
example_note: The final token repeats an earlier token; the model predicts what followed its earlier occurrence.
learning_objectives: Trace a previous-token feature into a later query-key match
hints: The circuit has an early feature-writing stage and a later retrieval stage.
At the final position, inspect layer 1 head 1.
Find earlier positions whose previous token matches the final token.
Ablate both the feature writer and retrieval head.
starter_code:
def solve(model, tokenizer, dataset, tools):
    tokens = dataset[0]["tokens"]
    print("Induction accuracy:", tools.evaluate(dataset)["accuracy"])
    pattern = tools.attention(tokens, 1, 1)
    print("Final query attention:", pattern[-1])
    first_stage = tools.ablate_head(tokens, 0, 0)
    second_stage = tools.ablate_head(tokens, 1, 1)
    print("Ablations:", first_stage, second_stage)
    return {"components": [{"type": "attention_head", "layer": 0, "head": 0}, {"type": "attention_head", "layer": 1, "head": 1}]}

explanation.canonical_solution: Layer 0 head 0 writes the previous token identity into a dedicated residual feature. Layer 1 head 1 queries for a prior position with that previous-token feature matching the current token, then copies the token that followed the prior match.
explanation.caution: An induction-like attention pattern is not enough. Ablate each stage and check held-out sequences.

grading_contract.checks: Must identify exactly heads (layer 0, head 0) and (layer 1, head 1).

grading_contract.type: list[{type: ablation, layer: int, head: int, measured values: float}]
grading_contract.checks: Must record both head ablations with drop > 0.5. Hidden baseline must be ≥ 0.95 and mean hidden drop ≥ 0.5.

tool_reference.name: tools
tool_reference.description: A helper object passed into solve(...). Use it to measure behavior and inspect or intervene on this challenge model.

tool_reference.name: tools.evaluate(dataset)
tool_reference.description: Measures task performance across records. Returns accuracy, correct, and total.

tool_reference.name: tools.attention(tokens, layer, head)
tool_reference.description: Returns the attention matrix. Row i shows where the query at token position i reads; columns are key positions.

tool_reference.name: tools.ablate_head(tokens, layer, head)
tool_reference.type: dict: {type:str, layer:int, head:int, before:float, after:float, drop:float}
tool_reference.description: Temporarily zeros one head and measures task accuracy before and after. Records an ablation event; drop is before minus after.

tool_reference.name: tools.ablation_sweep(tokens)
tool_reference.description: Runs ablate_head on every head for one token sequence, sorted by largest accuracy drop. Pass tokens, e.g. dataset[0]["tokens"], not the whole dataset.

tool_reference.name: tools.activation(tokens, name)
tool_reference.description: Reads a named activation tensor, such as a residual stream or MLP activation.

tool_reference.name: tools.logit_lens(tokens, layer=None)
tool_reference.description: Projects a residual stream through the unembedding to see token scores at a layer.

tool_reference.name: tools.weight(name, layer=None, head=None)
tool_reference.description: Reads a model weight matrix, such as W_Q, W_K, W_V, or W_O.
